verdict.rationale: Mastra's pricing page offers to "Self host your Mastra projects" free and Apache 2.0 licensed, to "build and host agents anywhere." The deployment docs say apps run on any Node.js-compatible environment, Bun, Deno or Cloudflare, either as a standalone Mastra server or inside an existing web framework, and Studio runs locally at localhost:4111. A community comment says an earlier release used the Elastic v2 license, which still permits self-hosting but bars resale as a managed service, so the openness terms are less certain than the docs suggest. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted production deployment, and confirmation of the current license terms.
